headline: India Extends Agriculture Infrastructure Fund to March 2027
summary: The Indian government has extended its Agriculture Infrastructure Fund until March 31, 2027, continuing subsidised credit and loan guarantees for post-harvest facilities including cold storages and processing centres.
why: The Agriculture Infrastructure Fund provides public financing to modernise rural supply chains. Upgraded storage infrastructure helps mitigate crop wastage and smooth agricultural supply shocks.

impacts.name: Agriculture
impacts.why: Subsidised loans and credit guarantees encourage private capital expenditure on cold chain and storage assets.
